Medium view inside Kulturhuset Stadsteatern exhibition space where a woman in a grey coat stands before a textile sculpture, natural daylight streaming from clerestory windows casting gentle shadows across the installation.

Environmental photograph of Liljevalchs konsthall Stockholm exhibition room, high ceilings with exposed beams, visitors seated on a long bench contemplating mixed-media wall works, diffused daylight entering through tall glass doors.

Close detail of a sculptural installation corner: folded linen draping over a wooden armature, warm afternoon light revealing woven texture, no people in frame, set within a Stockholm utställning gallery.
